evidence.title: Photorealistic Novel View Synthesis of Human Faces using Next-Scale Transformers

summary: Researchers unveiled a next-scale transformer architecture capable of synthesizing photorealistic novel viewpoints of human faces from limited input images, markedly improving visual fidelity and detail. The approach outperforms prior view synthesis methods and has implications for graphics, AR/VR, and deepfake detection.
title: Next-Scale Transformers Generate Photorealistic Novel Views of Human Faces
